short_name.notes: Official abbreviation CUNI/CU appears in URL domain (cuni.cz) without a dedicated short_name specification.

min_standing_note.notes: Managed at faculty/agreement level under Inter-University Agreements (https://cuni.cz/UKEN-179.html); no uniform university-wide year-of-study rule verified.

excluded_majors.notes: Faculty-specific capacity/course prerequisites vary across Charles University's 17 faculties.

min_gpa_host.notes: No fixed numeric minimum GPA published on cuni.cz Inter-University Agreement incoming page (academic standing/transcript reviewed holistically by host faculty).

instruction_languages.notes: Wide English-taught exchange course catalog alongside Czech-taught offerings.

english_course_availability.notes: University-wide English course catalogue available to incoming exchange students across faculties.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 English minimum required for English-taught courses (IELTS >=5.5, TOEFL iBT >=72, TOEFL ITP >=543); exempt if prior degree study is taught completely in English with institutional confirmation.

host_language_requirement.value: None required if taking English-taught courses; Czech B2 needed for Czech-taught coursework.

fall_term_dates.value: Winter/First Semester typically runs late September/early October through mid-February (exact start/exam windows decentralized by individual faculty; e.g., classes Oct-Dec/Jan, exams Jan-Feb).

spring_term_dates.value: Summer/Spring Semester typically runs mid-February through late June/early July (exact start/exam dates decentralized by faculty).

tuition_model.notes: Students nominated under bilateral Inter-University Agreements are exempt from Charles University tuition fees.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official cuni.cz living expenses estimate: EUR 550-600/month (modest dormitory lifestyle) to EUR 800-1,000/month (private/shared apartment lifestyle), incl. shared dorm ~EUR 180 (4,500 CZK), single dorm ~EUR 260, shared flat EUR 400-520, groceries EUR 140-250.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly EUR range 550-1,000 (midpoint 775.0)/month. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD from ECB Euro reference exchange rates (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 775.0 EUR * 5 * 1.1052 = 4,282.65 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition waived; mandatory comprehensive travel/medical health insurance required by Czech law for non-EU visa/residence permit holders plus refundable dormitory caution deposit (see UKEN-365 / UKEN-366).

housing_availability.notes: Charles University Dormitories and Refectories allocates double/twin dorm rooms via online portal (e.g., Větrník, Hvězda, Kajetánka, Hostivař, 17. listopadu); refundable deposit required and space is subject to application timelines.

housing_notes.value: Shared dorm room ~EUR 180/mo (~4,500 CZK); single dorm ~EUR 260/mo; private shared apartment EUR 400-520/mo; Prague subsidized student transit ~720 CZK for 3 months.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Note: UKEN-178.html is a Post-Doc/research grant fund NOT for incoming exchange students; no incoming bilateral exchange stipend published on UKEN-179.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students staying >90 days must apply for a Czech Long-Term Visa/Residence Permit for study at a Czech Embassy prior to departure, with acceptance letter, housing proof, comprehensive health insurance, and bank balance financial proof.

course_catalog_url.notes: Official Student Information System (SIS) course catalog.

english_course_list_url.notes: Dedicated Charles University English-language incoming course catalogue guide.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; full-time semester load typically ~30 ECTS (subject to faculty/home-university Learning Agreement approval).

course_restrictions_note.value: Incoming students enroll primarily within their hosting faculty (may request select courses in other faculties subject to seat availability/faculty approval); exact academic calendars vary by faculty.

value: English B2 proficiency proof (or English-medium degree confirmation)

academic_style.notes: Decentralized 17-faculty Central European research university structure; exact pedagogical format varies by host faculty.

city_tier.notes: Located in Prague (Czech Republic capital), though cuni.cz living-cost pages do not specify population bracket metrics explicitly.

campus_type.notes: Multi-faculty city distribution across Prague; official campus_type label not explicitly classified on verified cuni.cz pages.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: English widely used in Prague university centers/student services, though Czech is the everyday municipal language; no official level rating published on cuni.cz.

international_support_services.value: Charles University European Office / International Relations Office, Central Library, Orientation Days, and CU Point student support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Inter-University Agreements: Winter semester Nomination Mar 10, Application Mar 31 (Apr 30 for DE/CH); Summer/Spring semester Nomination Sep 10, Application Sep 30 (Oct 30 for DE/CH).
